paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: : Compare with noise input on MMAR
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates model accuracy on the MMAR benchmark when given the intended audio input versus a noise input, with a dashed reference line indicating “Random Choice.” The horizontal axis contains three categorical model names in left-to-right order: “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni.” The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale spanning roughly 0 to a little above 60, with regularly spaced tick marks at about 10-percentage-point intervals. For each model, two adjacent bars are shown: an “Audio” bar in medium blue and a “Noise” bar in purple (as indicated by the legend), forming grouped pairs per category. For “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” the Audio bar reaches about 30% and the Noise bar about 23–24%. For “Audio-Reasoner,” the Audio bar is about 36–37% and the Noise bar about 30–31%. For “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” the Audio bar is about 56–57% and the Noise bar about 36–37%. A light blue dashed horizontal line labeled “Random Choice” runs across the plot at approximately 29% accuracy. The bars are not shown as explicitly sorted by value and there is no additional visual emphasis such as outlines or per-bar annotations beyond the legend and the dashed reference line.
